identification: About 40 boxed 1:43 and 1:24 diecast: c.15 Solido Age d'Or (Cadillac Commercial, Rolls-Royce Cabriolet, Ford T Tourer, Delahaye, Talbot etc.) in perspex cases, plus MGB, Mercedes 300SL, Jaguar E-type (boxed), Welly NEX, Bburago, Collector's Edition, Back to the Future DeLorean, Transformers 1977 Camaro Bumblebee. Mostly budget modern models; Solido Age d'Or is the only series with a modest collector following.

viewing_check: Count the Solido Age d'Or cars and check each is complete in its case with plinth and no cracks; look for any scarcer models (Delahaye, Packard, Duesenberg-type) and for Collector's Edition / Mercedes 300SL makers (Maisto/Bburago vs premium brands). Confirm the Transformers Camaro and Back to the Future DeLorean are genuine boxed (Jada/Hollywood Rides), and check for box damage.
